name: Nook
description:
Your smart home from the top bar: lights, plugs, sensors, cameras, air conditioners, TVs and speakers, from Home Assistant, Hue, HomeKit, Smart Life, Mi Home, eWeLink and the local network.

While the screen is locked, Nook only turns Xiaomi gateway leak and smoke alerts into notifications. Pairing an Android TV needs openssl. The copy button for donation addresses uses the clipboard; nothing is read from it.
